thread:
omar-legal: Hey finance, I booked a hotel in Berlin for the EU partner summit and the invoice PDF the hotel gave is missing the VAT number and doesn't show VAT breakdown. We need a proper VAT invoice to reclaim VAT. The charge was 
C428.90 on my corporate card.

nina-sales: I stayed too. The front desk said they issue invoices on request but often send a generic receipt. Did you ask for a fiscal invoice with the hotel's VAT ID and my company name?

lisa-travel: Hotels here usually provide a "Rechnung" with Steuernummer. If they only give a credit card receipt it's not enough for reclaim. Could you request the invoice and ask them to add "Redwood Inference GmbH" and our address + VAT ID? I can send the template wording.

omar-legal: Good point. I emailed the hotel accounting and asked them to reissue with: "Redwood Inference GmbH, Unter den Linden 20, 10117 Berlin, VAT DE123456789" and to show VAT amount per line.

kai-finance: Thanks. For bookkeeping we need the supplier VAT number, invoice number, invoice date, line-level VAT amount and currency. If they can't provide, we can't reclaim VAT and bookkeeping needs to post the gross expense. Please keep the corp-card posted USD amount screenshot too.

expensebot: ExpenseBot: Parsed original receipt attached. Flag: missing supplier VAT number and missing VAT breakdown. Recommended action: obtain invoice with VAT ID and line VAT.

omar-legal: Hotel replied: they can issue a pro forma with VAT shown but said they need the company registration docs to add a foreign company VAT ID. Is that normal?

lisa-travel: Some German hotels are strict; they may require an EU VAT registration proof. Try asking for "reverse charge" wording if they can't post DE VAT for foreign entity. But if the hotel charges gross and posts DE VAT we can reclaim via VAT reclaim process only if invoice is proper.

kai-finance: If they refuse to provide a valid VAT invoice, we will code the full 
C428.90 to GL 6505 (Travel - Lodging - Non-reclaimable VAT) and mark as non-reclaimable. If they can supply a corrected invoice we will file reclaim and adjust GL to net amount + VAT receivable. Please attach correspondence when they send it.

nina-sales: I've DM'ed the hotel contact and offered to provide a company registration PDF. Omar, want me to push it?

omar-legal: Yes please, Nina. Also ask them to include invoice number and to email accounting@redwood-inference.de.

expensebot: ExpenseBot: Reminder: if claiming VAT back later, attach original credit-card charge, corrected invoice PDF, and proof of payment. Finance will process VAT reclaim in quarterly EU VAT filing.

kai-finance: Once we have the invoice, I'll confirm whether we can reclaim. If not, we'll proceed with reimbursement as posted and note the non-reclaimable VAT flag.

omar-legal: Thanks all — I'll hold off on final coding until we get the invoice.
